input: Supplied labelled Boolean cube; all inputs admitted, including prior-zero inputs
adequacy: Complete supplied finite relation, with empty rows exposing infeasibility
controller: Any finite deterministic exact coordinate-query tree; repeated queries permitted
query_cost: Fixed supplied finite nonnegative rational vector for each coordinate
terminal_cost: Supplied finite nonnegative rational vector for each input/action pair, charged once after the leaf action is selected
observation: Only queried coordinate values are available before choosing an action; terminal cost reveals nothing beforehand
invariant: Labelled-subcube terminal profile antichains for frontiers; complete terminal profile sets for complete no-repeat profiles
optimization: One attainable joint pointwise profile, followed by coordinatewise nondecreasing functionals and upper-bound constraints
